summary.text: The story follows the planeswalkers' covert descent into New Phyrexia, the Phyrexian-ruled Mirrodin, where Jace Beleren leads a strike team carrying the sylex to the base of the World Tree before it can connect through the Blind Eternities.

Infection, grief and doubt wear the team down, with Nahiri hiding a Phyrexian spike and Vraska turning against Jace, until Jace hides behind an illusion to activate the sylex and Elspeth Tirel runs him through and vanishes with it beyond the Blind Eternities.
The mission fails: Realmbreaker sends its branches of Phyrexian invaders to other planes, and Elesh Norn welcomes the survivors to Phyrexia as the invasion begins.
